text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 1896/21 – WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 07, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: ACQ/O/J/D/101.

Ministry No. : 4-3/4/2014/D/101. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government indents to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: Preliminary plan: Ya 2777; Situation Village: Karanavai; GN Division: Karanavai, East. J/351; DS Division: Vadamaradchchi, South West; District: Jaffna; Province: Northern.
Lot No. 01

Name of the Land: Avalappulam; Description: Garden contains Seasonal Cropas; Name of the Claimant: K. Thavachelvam, No. 462/4, Segul Court, Hamton Lane, Wellawatta, Colombo 06; Extent: 0.1434 Hectare.
Lot No. 02
Name of the Land: Avalappulam; Description: Way and Water Course; Name of the Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 0.0025 Hectare.
Lot No. 03

Name of the Land: Avalappulam; Description: Garden contains Seasonal Cropas; Name of the Claimant: K. Thavachelvam, No. 462/4, Segul Court, Hamton Lane, Wellawatta, Colombo 06; Extent: 0.0216 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Vadamaradchchi, South West/ Karaveddy on the 18th Wednesday of February, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 5th of February, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particular of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
WICKRAMA WARAGODA, Acquiring Officer (LLRC) District Secretariat, Jaffna. Ministry of land & Land Development, District Office, District Secretariat, Jaffna, 01st January, 2015.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: ACQ/O/J/D/111.

Ministry No. : 4-3/4/2014/D/111. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government indents to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose;

Description of the land to be Acquired: Preliminary plan: Ya 2759; Situation Village: Chavakachcheri, South; GN Division: Kovilkudiyiruppu, J/301; DS Division: Thenmaradchi/Chavakachcheri; District: Jaffna; Province: Northern.
Lot No. 01
Name of the Land: Nerunchi Thoddam; Description: Garden contains Mixed Cultivation and a masonry wells; Name of the Claimant: Rajappu Felix Augasta Amaleswaran; Extent: 0.5107 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Chavakachcheri on the 11th Wednesday of February, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 28th Wednesday of January 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particular of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
WICKRAMA WARAGODA, Acquiring Officer (LLRC) District Secretariat, Jaffna. Ministry of Land & Land Development, District Office, District Secretariat, Jaffna, 31st December, 2014.
